mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear 31 degrees at Fireman's Park, with a waning crescent moon visible in the sky.

Regarding city updates, road crews will be performing asphalt repairs on November 10 and 11, which will affect parking on several streets including North Nine Mound Road and Morningside Boulevard from 7 AM to 7 PM. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to review various development projects, including the Sub-Zero expansion at Liberty Business Park, during their meeting on December 7.

We have a busy schedule ahead, starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market today. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's today, followed by live music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow and yoga at Insight Wellness on November 9.

Looking at the latest police report, officers responded on October 25 to a report of a vehicle stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, where a man was taken into custody for O W I.
Stop by for today's flavor of the day, which is the delicious Andes Mint Avalanche. The store is closed right now, but it opens today at 10:00 AM.
